description: This file defines the class OA_DB_AdvisoryLock_pgsql, which implements advisory lock operations for PostgreSQL within the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for acquiring, releasing, and checking support for advisory locks, as well as generating lock IDs.

classes.name: OA_DB_AdvisoryLock_pgsql
classes.description: Implements advisory lock functionality for PostgreSQL in the OpenXDB package, providing methods to acquire, release, and verify support for advisory locks.

methods.name: _getLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire an advisory lock with optional wait time, using PostgreSQL functions.

methods.name: _releaseLock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired advisory lock.

methods.name: _isLockingSupported
methods.description: Checks if the connected PostgreSQL database version supports advisory locks (version >= 8.2).

methods.name: _getId
methods.description: Generates a lock ID based on a lock name and platform hash, serialized as a string.
